playbook.name: Matter/Project Activity Summary
playbook.description: Notifies the user of sprk_event records of any event type modified in the last 24 hours on their matters, on matters they own, or that they own. The 24-hour window is fixed (the scheduler passes timeWindowHours=24; it is not "since the last check" and the timeWindow parameter is not applied yet). Uses Spaarke custom sprk_event entity. Surfaces general activity stream, distinct from the type-specific new-events playbook.

timeWindow.description: How far back to look for matter activity

configJson.description: Scoped to current user's matters via LookupUserMembership

Resolve the matters FOR the executing user via the people-targeting surface (targeting: people, ADR-034 Amendment A3): records they created (human Created By), are named on (Assigned To, via their linked contact) or personally own — never matters reached only through team, business-unit or organization ownership. Bound to `myMatters.ids` for downstream filtering (the query writes them as <value> children with fetchInGuids).

configJson.fetchXml: <fetch top="50"><entity name="sprk_event"><attribute name="sprk_eventname"/><attribute name="sprk_eventid"/><attribute name="sprk_eventtype_ref"/><attribute name="statuscode"/><attribute name="createdon"/><attribute name="modifiedon"/><attribute name="sprk_regardingrecordname"/><attribute name="sprk_regardingrecordurl"/><attribute name="sprk_regardingmatter"/><attribute name="sprk_regardingproject"/><attribute name="ownerid"/><link-entity name="sprk_matter" from="sprk_matterid" to="sprk_regardingmatter" link-type="outer" alias="m"><attribute name="sprk_mattername"/><attribute name="sprk_matternumber"/><attribute name="ownerid"/></link-entity><filter type="and"><condition attribute="modifiedon" operator="last-x-hours" value="{{timeWindowHours}}"/><filter type="or"><condition attribute="sprk_regardingmatter" operator="in">{{fetchInGuids myMatters.ids}}</condition><condition entityname="m" attribute="ownerid" operator="eq-userid"/><condition attribute="ownerid" operator="eq-userid"/></filter></filter><order attribute="modifiedon" descending="true"/></entity></fetch>
configJson.description: sprk_event rows of any event type modified in the last 24 hours (timeWindowHours; the scheduler passes 24), where (a) sprk_regardingmatter is one of the user's matters (myMatters.ids from Lookup My Matters, written as <value> children by fetchInGuids; an empty list matches nothing), OR (b) the linked matter's owner is the user, OR (c) the event's own owner is the user. The matter link is outer. Newest modifiedon first, at most 50.
